answer: Gate identity behind a sponsorship thread: newcomers toil on low-value tasks until fifteen graded jobs pass, then an incumbent pledging 40 epochs of locked rewards may vouch. Overlapping vouchers on an alias merge into one cluster, so a farm stitching aliases onto one sponsor exposes all to a single slashing event. Instant payout is the nectar sybils chase, but rewards vest along that same thread, and reputation ripens only near its zenith of continuous verified work. Each fake identity needs a fresh sponsor bond and inherits the whole risk, making duplication costlier than genuine labor.
